name: Override Weather - API
command:
// overrideWeather(type, temp, dayDelta)
// type: String (see below)
// temp: Number (ºF)
// dayDelta: Number (>=0) Day offset, ie 1 is tomorrow (optional)
//
/* VALID WEATHER TYPES:
 * none           - Clear / Sunny
 * partlyCloudy   - Scattered Clouds
 * clouds         - Overcast
 * lightRain      - Light Rain
 * rain           - Rain
 * heavyRain      - Heavy Rain
 * rainStorm      - Storm
 * fog            - Fog
 * hail           — Hail
 * snow           - Heavy Snow
 * lightSnow      — Snow
 * blizzard       - Blizzard
 * leaves         - Windy / Autumn Leaves
 * sandstorm      - Sandstorm
 * heatWave       - Heat Wave
 * aurora         - Aurora (night only)
 * lightWind      - Light Wind with overlay
 */

game.modules.get('wgtgm-mini-calendar').api.overrideWeather("aurora", 35);
